- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: lines 46-61 (the while-loop case statement)
  Problem: The new self-contained render_prompt.sh only substitutes three hardcoded placeholders — {{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}, {{SEMBLE_PREFETCH}}, and {{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}. The old code (via render_prompt.py) dynamically discovered every {{PLACEHOLDER_NAME}} in the template and forwarded matching env vars. This PR removes that dynamic resolution.
  Why it fails at runtime: When the resolver sets env vars like PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_NUMBER=1 and MAX_ATTEMPTS=3, the new while-loop passes every line through the case statement, which matches none of those env-var placeholders and falls through to the wildcard arm — emitting the literal text {{PREVIOUS_ATTEMPT_NUMBER}} and {{MAX_ATTEMPTS}} into the rendered prompt.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Problem: The removal of `memory_force_tick_get` and `memory_force_tick_put` functions breaks the cooldown/throttling subsystem used by `scripts/orchestrate_force_tick.sh`.
  Why: The force-tick helpers are gone from `memory_helpers.sh`, so the feature no longer has the functions it expects after sourcing the file.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh:46-80 (new while-read loop)
  Line or code reference: case "${trimmed_line}" in "{{WORKFLOW_EDIT_RESTRICTION}}") ... "{{SERENA_TOOL_HINTS}}") ... *) printf '%s\n' "${line}"
  Problem: Only three placeholders are explicitly handled; any other {{VAR}} in a prompt template falls through to the *) case and remains literally in the rendered output.
  Why it fails at runtime: Prompt passed to Codex will contain unresolved placeholders, so the model receives malformed instructions or missing context blocks.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/build_state_snapshot.py:354-360 (_resolve_memory_roots)
  Line or code reference: except MemoryGitError: return schema_root, None, None
  Problem: When read_memory_root_from_branch raises MemoryGitError the branch clone is silently skipped and ledger_memory_root becomes None.
  Why it fails at runtime: `substate`/token fields are omitted on every transient git error without warning or fallback to the GitHub API path.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:656-662 (branch publication)
  Line or code reference: if [ -n "$(git -C "${PUBLISH_DIR}" status --porcelain)" ]; then ... git push --quiet --force ...
  Problem: The publication step always uses --force and never checks the remote branch's HEAD commit.
  Why it fails at runtime: When STATE_SNAPSHOT_BRANCH_ENABLED=true the branch can lose history on every tick because a concurrent run can be overwritten without any merge or conflict detection.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/memory_helpers.sh (entire diff deleting 413 lines of force-tick helpers)
  Line or code reference: removal of _memory_force_tick_* family and memory_force_tick_get/put at the bottom of the file
  Problem: The functions that implement cooldown, branch-initialization, and collision detection for force-tick have been deleted without updating callers or providing a replacement.
  Why it fails at runtime: Orchestrator stall/judge recovery or manual force-tick will fail with undefined functions; the cooldown-enforced guarantee disappears.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
